notes: Riverwalk by day. The stage-mistress's dugout (boat.riverwalk.stage-canoe) is hers, tied at her landing; she stands at her stall in sight. The player boards it unpaid and casts off: the take is a theft of the boat's value, filed on the Owing ledger as seen by her.

steps.name: board
steps.transition: E at the canoe: the player steps aboard

steps.name: cast-off
steps.transition: E aboard: the canoe casts off from her landing unpaid; she sees it, the take is filed as theft

steps.name: paddle-out
steps.transition: W on the paddle towards the cove beach

steps.name: save-and-load
steps.transition: save adrift and load: the boat records and the hulls come back as they were
